post_interview_reconciliation.original_question: Under what conditions may sources move to wiki-spike, and what happens to the prior systems?
post_interview_reconciliation.reconciliation: Authorize the Mac-first private cutover and retention policy only. Migrate exactly one enabled source at a time into a non-serving final-workspace cohort. A cohort may be considered for activation only after at least one full signed observation day, 200 parity cases per source, 500 cohort E2E queries, one-sided 95% Wilson lower bounds meeting the frozen DB-05 floors, zero safety violations, an unchanged holdout, and separate migration, quality, security, and product approvals. Before the first canonical mutation, emergency rollback is allowed only from ROUTE_SWITCHED_NO_MUTATION to the exact read-only pre-cutover surface with banner and write freeze. The first canonical mutation permanently closes legacy rollback; subsequent failure must disable or abstain. Prior GO source systems remain read-only until trusted activation time plus exactly 90 times 24 hours. This record supplies policy authorization only and supplies no shadow, cutover, activation, retention-completion, decommission, deletion, or revocation evidence.
